6. The present petition has been filed with prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 21.3.2024 registered as Case Crime No. 25 of 2024 under Sections 498A, 354, 504, 506, 313 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Mahila Thana, District Ghaziabad.

8. The petition stands dismissed for want of prosecution.
